name: West Palm Beach

queries.query: West Palm Beach Florida official parcel GIS property appraiser parcel data feature service
queries.scope: Find city/county first-party parcel map and determine whether public geometry can be read safely.
queries.result: Official City GIS metadata exposes a polygon Parcels feature layer copied monthly from Palm Beach County; official County Property Appraiser GIS identifies the county map as the official property-ownership map. A safe county-level exact-point query returned one full polygon with only OBJECTID. The WUP locator projects outside the City GIS layer extent, so the County sample is not claimed as city-bound.

queries.query: Palm Beach County Property Appraiser GIS official parcel map West Palm Beach City parcel
queries.scope: Verify the county’s local parcel-maintenance role and the City GIS copy relationship.
queries.result: Palm Beach County Property Appraiser says it maintains the county official parcel ownership map; the City of West Palm Beach layer states it is downloaded from PBC monthly. No owner, address, assessment, tax, or transaction attributes were requested.

officialSources.observation: City layer Parcels is polygon geometry; its metadata says the data is downloaded from Palm Beach County on the first Monday monthly and staged/refreshed the following Sunday; it is used in public and internal applications.
County Property Appraiser describes the county GIS as the official parcel ownership map.
Public polygon layer metadata; safe query requested only OBJECTID and geometry.

serviceChecks.method: GET metadata via official ArcGIS REST page
serviceChecks.observation: Polygon layer in EPSG:2881; map supports query; schema also contains unrelated owner/address/value attributes, none requested.

serviceChecks.method: GET exact WUP point query via local shell, 15s timeout
serviceChecks.observation: No HTTP response; local request timed out. This is not evidence the provider is down.
County polygon layer in EPSG:3857; only system OBJECTID was requested in feature query.

serviceChecks.method: GET exact WUP point, outFields=OBJECTID, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, f=geojson
serviceChecks.observation: One full Polygon returned; WUP point is inside. County-wide result only; city-layer projected extent excludes point.

freshResearch.geometryDecision: One complete county geometry observed at the WUP locator and retained as a safe sample; it is not represented as city-bound because the City layer extent excludes the point.

source.name: Palm Beach County Property Appraiser parcel polygons; City of West Palm Beach monthly parcel copy
source.operator: Palm Beach County Property Appraiser; City of West Palm Beach GIS republishes a monthly copy
source.serviceType: Public ArcGIS MapServer polygon layer (county source); query used outFields=OBJECTID and full polygon geometry only.
source.update: City GIS metadata says downloaded first Monday of each month and refreshed the following Sunday.
source.scope: 114 valid distinct Palm Beach County Property Appraiser GIS reference polygons in thirteen bounded cells around the unchanged UN WUP West Palm Beach settlement locator. Native count/OID manifests, forced three-row pages, fresh GIS-ID geometry reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding pass. Metric EPSG32617 topology found no sampled overlap or errors. The county sample contains the locator; the separate municipal parcel layer extent excludes it. This serves the WUP settlement location using county ground and makes no West Palm Beach municipal-only coverage claim. Documented PCN/PARID is nonunique across geometry features, so it is not the runtime key.
